what.title: What are cookies?

what.p1: A cookie is a small file stored on your device (computer or phone). It helps a website remember information such as your session or preferences.
what.p2: Similar technologies (local storage, technical identifiers) may also be used to ensure security and proper operation.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy | GymWatch
metadata.description: How GymWatch collects, uses, and protects your personal data (Morocco).

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Clear information about the data we collect and how we protect it.
hero.disclaimer: This document is provided for information purposes and is not legal advice.

intro.title: Summary
intro.body: GymWatch is a gym-management SaaS. We do not process payments on the platform. We mainly collect contact data (email, phone) and operational data (addresses, members, subscriptions) to deliver the service.

collected.title: Data we collect
items: Identification & contact: first/last name, email, phone number.
Account data: identifiers, role, access logs, settings.
Operations data: addresses (club/network), member records, subscriptions, attendance, access control.
Technical data: basic usage logs, security logs, anti-abuse signals.

purposes.title: Why we use your data
items: Create and manage your account, teams, and locations.
Operate the service (subscriptions, access, attendance, reporting).
Communicate with you (support, replies, service notifications).
Secure the platform (fraud/abuse prevention, auditing, traceability).
Improve the product (aggregated usage insights, service quality).

legal.title: Legal basis & Morocco compliance
items: Service delivery: processing needed to provide GymWatch.
Consent: where required (e.g., non-essential communications).
Legitimate interests: security, abuse prevention, service improvement.
Reference to Morocco’s personal data framework (Law 09-08) and CNDP requirements where applicable.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep data only as long as needed for the service, then delete/archive it according to legal obligations and security/audit needs.

security.title: Security
security.body: Encryption in transit, access controls, logging, backups, and organizational measures to reduce unauthorized access.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access, correction, and updating of your data.
Objection or limitation in certain cases.
Deletion (subject to legal/contractual constraints).
Contact support for any privacy-related request.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For privacy questions or requests, contact us by email or via the Contact page.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy to reflect product changes or legal requirements. The latest version is published on this page.

accordion.title: Frequently asked questions
accordion.description: Multi-site, analytics, access control and roadmap — it’s all here.

items.question: What is GymWatch?
items.answer: GymWatch is a web platform to run your gyms: subscriptions, payments, access control and reporting — all in real time from a browser.

items.question: Does GymWatch support multiple gyms or franchises?
items.answer: Yes. The multi-site view lets you track each club (members, revenue, check-ins) and aggregate key metrics across the network.

items.question: Do I need to install software?
items.answer: No. GymWatch is 100% web-based. QR codes and scanning work from a tablet or a connected smartphone.

items.question: How do upgrades from Basic to Pro / Enterprise work?
items.answer: You can change plans anytime. Pro/Enterprise unlock QR tools, CSV/PDF exports, detailed analytics and advanced automation scenarios.

items.question: Can I start with one location and add more later?
items.answer: Yes. Add new locations in a few clicks and link teams and members. Permissions and reports can be filtered per location.

items.question: How are data and security handled?
items.answer: Data is encrypted in transit and backed up regularly. Access is tied to admin accounts with roles, plus audit logging and environment separation best practices.

sarah.quote: Automated reminders lowered our unpaid invoices and freed time at the front desk. Premium interface, zero friction.
sarah.author: Sarah M.

youssef.quote: Onboarding in 48 hours, responsive team, secure data. It’s the gym SaaS we were looking for.
youssef.author: Youssef K.

q1.question: Does the software support multi-club / multi-site networks?
q1.answer: Yes. GymWatch provides a consolidated view and per-club filters for members, memberships, access control and reporting.

q2.question: How does access control work?
q2.answer: QR codes or badges, real-time validation and instant alerts. Permissions are driven by location, membership type and time slots.

q3.question: Can reminders and payments be automated?
q3.answer: Yes, email/SMS reminders for due dates and failed payments are built-in. Invoices are generated automatically and can be exported.

q4.question: Is there help for rollout and onboarding?
q4.answer: Our team helps you migrate data, configure access and train staff in just a few days.

q5.question: Is the service secure?
q5.answer: Encryption, backups, granular roles and audit logs of sensitive actions for reliable gym management software.
